name: csharp-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of C# and .NET, kept locally: the language, .NET, ASP.NET Core, EF Core and the API reference, WPF and Windows Forms, .NET MAUI, xUnit.net, NUnit and Polly. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look an API up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of C# and .NET: the C# language, .NET guides, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, the .NET API reference, WPF (XAML, data binding, styles), Windows Forms, .NET MAUI, xUnit.net (facts, theories), NUnit and Polly (retry, circuit breaker). Returns 10 section ids at most.
